initial_design_scope: One actual internal load-carrying web/node in a wide closed housing; preserve the continuous torsion shell until a full 3D multi-load design can justify changing it
non_design_void_features: Actual bearing/cup bore and rotating clearances
Removable joint covers and seal seats

load_case_requirements.scope: Static structural challenge; no automatic 3t locomotion requirement
Rejected G3 B load path only; must regenerate from new actual eyes and Jacobian before use
Separate hypothetical stop mechanism, not existing B hardware; release/unload must be possible
Required and unresolved; static 3t permission does not eliminate this case
Required for assembly qualification; 2D compliance does not represent these effects

boundary_missing: Actual parent/child solid topology and accepted component source
SKF O/X pressure-centre positions, actual fits, preload and load sharing
Mount bolt patterns/pretension and frame compliance
Bearing and stop contact tractions rather than fully fixed arbitrary faces
Actual actuator attachment and normal-operation force spectrum
Manufacturing process and minimum member/void sizes
Owner-specific part interfaces and maintenance exclusions

constraints: Density constant through a declared extrusion direction
Enforce minimum member and cutter-accessible voids
Allow only separately justified drilling/bolted joins
Separate support removal and post-machined bearing seats

final_checks_required: Watertight signed finite material meshes and actual net mass
No disconnected material from each load patch to supports
Contact, bearing load/fit, joint fatigue and motion/maintenance checks
Comparison against same-interface full-solid and G4 rib-shell baselines
